allowlist_rule: REQ-XD-106 — an hh-l1-canon/<v> rule change after a recorded gate run requires a version bump and a rerun on an unused gate partition; check_gate_run refuses both violations typed

dev_projection.rule: REQ-XH-114 + REQ-XH-121 — the sealed dev projection (verdict, reward and verifier fields removed) is the only corpus input H development reads; the gate partitions stay sealed — their digests alone bind the corpus input

digest_rule: sha256 over Json::to_canonical_string of each partition's {members, name, tasks, trajectories} — the corpus's partition input is frozen by digest (REQ-XD-106)
freeze_state: blocked — recorded, never hidden: every member carries its slot's freeze state verbatim (blocked{un_reproofed_successor}, blocked{no_adjacent_donor}); the partition describes the intended layout while task_lists.state governs admission — W1's re-proof register recorded every drawn member excluded oracle_fails_on_O and the successors are un-re-proofed
gate_consumption: the gate partitions are consumed by L1 gate runs only; a run's hh-l1-conformance/1 pass id is what unblocks the HH-native arm — the runner withholds a native-lane unit without an exact-H pass: withheld{l1_not_passed}, pair-atomic (R6.41's drive_window refusal, cited verbatim)
rule: partitions are by task (REQ-XD-106): the 7 fp_dev7 slots in committed order, keyed sha256(seed|fp_dev7|cell|slot), sorted ascending; first 3 → dev, next 2 → gate_a, last 2 → gate_b — 3/2/2 tasks, 12/8/8 trajectories at 4 per task (REQ-XH-114)
seed_basis: committed before drawing — the R6.33 prereg declares no corpus-partition seed (schedule.seed is the W4 interleave); this seed is committed in this record, outcome-blind by construction: the task_lists carry freeze states, never outcome fields (REQ-XH-114)

source.corpus_status: withheld{un_reproofed_successor:task_lists_state=blocked} — the R6.40 CORPUS leg verbatim; the partition is over the drawn task list, not trajectory outputs (the corpus's execution records do not exist — never invented)

pin.dataset_toml_digests: pending{w1_observe_ingest} — hh-harbor-ingest/1 per-task digests bind before the post-replacement list freezes; never invented
